pages.quiz:
THEATRE AND FILM — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: THEATRE AND FILM
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. Only the volume
   C. The speed of the music
   D. The ticket price

2. Best practice when working on Play Writing 1.3 Poetry Writing 2.0 Production 2.1Acting 2.2Theatre Directing 2.: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Play Writing 1.3 Poetry Writing 2.0 Production 2.1Acting 2.2Theatre Directing 2..
   B. Disrupt classmates during Play Writing 1.3 Poetry Writing 2.0 Production 2.1Acting 2.2Theatre Directing 2..
   C. Damage equipment used for Play Writing 1.3 Poetry Writing 2.0 Production 2.1Acting 2.2Theatre Directing 2..
   D. Practise Play Writing 1.3 Poetry Writing 2.0 Production 2.1Acting 2.2Theatre Directing 2. with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. Best practice when working on Play Writing: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Play Writing.
   B. Damage equipment used for Play Writing.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Play Writing.
   D. Practise Play Writing with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. Best practice when working on Poetry writing – Spoken word: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Poetry writing – Spoken word.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Poetry writing – Spoken word.
   C. Practise Poetry writing – Spoken word with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Poetry writing – Spoken word.

5. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Remove the need for rules
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Guarantee a trophy

6. Best practice when working on Acting: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Acting.
   B. Practise Acting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Acting.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Acting.

7. Best practice when working on Theatre Adjudication: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Theatre Adjudication.
   B. Practise Theatre Adjudication with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Theatre Adjudication.
   D. Damage equipment used for Theatre Adjudication.

8. Best practice when working on Acting 2.2Theatre Directing 2.3 Theatre Design 3.0 Theatre, Film and Society 3.1: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Acting 2.2Theatre Directing 2.3 Theatre Design 3.0 Theatre, Film and Society 3.1.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Acting 2.2Theatre Directing 2.3 Theatre Design 3.0 Theatre, Film and Society 3.1.
   C. Practise Acting 2.2Theatre Directing 2.3 Theatre Design 3.0 Theatre, Film and Society 3.1 with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Acting 2.2Theatre Directing 2.3 Theatre Design 3.0 Theatre, Film and Society 3.1.

9. Best practice when working on Theatre Design: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Theatre Design with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Theatre Design.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Theatre Design.
   D. Damage equipment used for Theatre Design.

10. Best practice when working on Theatre and Community: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Theatre and Community.
   B. Practise Theatre and Community with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Theatre and Community.
   D. Damage equipment used for Theatre and Community.

11. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Red, blue, and yellow
   D. Black, white, and grey

12. Best practice when working on Introduction to Traditional Kenyan Theatre: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Introduction to Traditional Kenyan Theatre.
   B. Practise Introduction to Traditional Kenyan Theatre with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Introduction to Traditional Kenyan Theatre.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Introduction to Traditional Kenyan Theatre.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Poetry writing – Spoken word and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Acting 2.2Theatre Directing 2.3 Theatre Design 3.0 Theatre, Film and Society 3.1 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Acting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Theatre Design 3.0 Theatre, Film and Society 3.1 Theatre Adjudication 3.2 Theatr and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — The speed of the music

2. D — Practise Play Writing 1.3 Poetry Writing 2.0 Production 2.1Acting 2.2Theatre Directing 2. with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. D — Practise Play Writing with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. C — Practise Poetry writing – Spoken word with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. C — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

6. B — Practise Acting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. B — Practise Theatre Adjudication with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. C — Practise Acting 2.2Theatre Directing 2.3 Theatre Design 3.0 Theatre, Film and Society 3.1 with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. A — Practise Theatre Design with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. B — Practise Theatre and Community with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. C — Red, blue, and yellow

12. B — Practise Introduction to Traditional Kenyan Theatre with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Poetry writing – Spoken word; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Acting 2.2Theatre Directing 2.3 Theatre Design 3.0 Theatre, Film and Society 3.1; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Acting; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Theatre Design 3.0 Theatre, Film and Society 3.1 Theatre Adjudication 3.2 Theatr; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
